mapper.select: select n.num, n.title, n.content, n.regdate, n.moddate, c.email as writer_email, c.name, c.password, c.from_social from note n join club_member c on n.writer_email = c.email order by n.num desc
mapper.insert: insert into note ( title, content, writer_email ) values ( #{title}, #{content}, #{writer.email} )
mapper.update: update note set title = #{title}, content = #{content} where num = #{num}
